Probe into donation irregularities at Badrinath and Ayodhya temples

Investigations are underway into alleged financial irregularities concerning donations at both the Badrinath and Ayodhya Ram temples. In Badrinath, a temple committee employee has been suspended and a high-level probe ordered. In Ayodhya, a Special Investigation Team (SIT) is examining donation processes, leading to resignations and calls for transparency, with some political parties protesting and advocating for digital payment systems.
